why: An inference from a price survey, not a statement that Starlink is on sale; the drafter flagged it.
Reported from unnamed sources as what operators may do, not a licence granted to a provider.

Starlink being the second-largest provider says nothing of a licence; Starlink is held as unlicensed in Sudan (SDN-006), so this is not a sale by a licensed provider; 4c 2026-11-28
